paragraphs: Yosef ben Elem, who served as High Priest, is mentioned in Bavli Yoma 12b. Hyman gives only Ben Elem for the passage near the end of Jerusalem Talmud Horayot, and Ben Ilim for Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1.

notes.text: The supplied Jerusalem Talmud Yoma locator is פ״א ה״א -ד. The extra ד is retained without asserting that it means folio 4 or establishing a historical pagination. The Elem/Ilim forms and the separate Bavli Yoma 12b citation remain distinct.

Bavli Yoma 12b recounts that Yosef ben Elem served in place of a disqualified High Priest. In the consulted Jerusalem Talmud, Horayot 3:2 names him בן אלם and Yoma 1:1 names him בן אילם, beside Hyman’s reported בן אלים in this entry. In his longer entry (vol. II, pp. 750–751), Hyman himself gives בן אילם for the Jerusalem Talmud Yoma and cites Bavli Horayot 12b, where the consulted text uses בן אילים.
